sets.label: casual founder-led outbound, hard word cap
sets.sender_persona: founder at a small workflow-automation company
instructions: Never mention pricing.
Keep it under 90 words.
Do not ask a question in the first email.
Always reference something specific about their company.
No exclamation marks.
Sign off with a first name and company name on separate lines.

sets.label: casual tone, no pricing said or implied
sets.sender_persona: account executive at a customer-support tooling startup
instructions: Keep the tone casual and conversational, never corporate.
Do not use pricing words such as price, cost, or discount.
Do not imply pricing indirectly with phrases like cost-effective, pays for itself, or ROI.
Keep it under 120 words.
Sign off with a first name and company name on separate lines.
